# Unicode IDNA provenance

The hostname processor uses **Unicode 17.0.0 UTS #46** nontransitional
processing with UseSTD3ASCIIRules, CheckHyphens, CheckBidi, CheckJoiners and,
for ToASCII, VerifyDnsLength. The retained sources are unmodified Unicode data:

| File | Upstream | Header date | SHA-256 | Bytes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IdnaMappingTable.txt` | [idna/IdnaMappingTable.txt](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/idna/IdnaMappingTable.txt) | 2025-07-25 | `87f05505dc026fdb2bff16132bdc68a8014675836882a9a2b1844540ad3be382` | 787378 |
| `IdnaTestV2.txt` | [idna/IdnaTestV2.txt](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/idna/IdnaTestV2.txt) | 2025-05-01 | `beb5d0be20e896189b03209a82fdc34f06351502bbd4b8e2523583fc2954d9cf` | 775973 |
| `UnicodeData.txt` | [ucd/UnicodeData.txt](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/UnicodeData.txt) | none (no header) | `2e1efc1dcb59c575eedf5ccae60f95229f706ee6d031835247d843c11d96470c` | 2198209 |
| `CompositionExclusions.txt` | [ucd/CompositionExclusions.txt](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/CompositionExclusions.txt) | 2025-08-01 | `2f239196ef3b5b61db5cc476e9bd80f534d15aa1b74e1be1dea5d042a344c85f` | 9007 |
| `DerivedJoiningType.txt` | [ucd/extracted/DerivedJoiningType.txt](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/extracted/DerivedJoiningType.txt) | 2025-06-30 | `f39ebe974825d6736aee15582250307aa532b2cfab3caf3f86bd23fddc9c5c4d` | 40635 |
| `NormalizationTest.txt` | [ucd/NormalizationTest.txt](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/NormalizationTest.txt) | 2025-06-30 | `5019ffd530751a741900c849c0e010332f142a3612234639bd200b82138a87db` | 2827429 |
| `LICENSE.txt` | [Unicode License v3](https://www.unicode.org/license.txt) | none | `e7a93b009565cfce55919a381437ac4db883e9da2126fa28b91d12732bc53d96` | 1995 |

The generated `internal/idna/tables.go` derives:

- from `IdnaMappingTable.txt`, each code point's status (valid, mapped,
  deviation, disallowed, ignored) and mapping. IDNA2008 NV8/XV8 values are not
  used. Deviation code points stay valid under nontransitional processing.
- from `UnicodeData.txt`, full canonical decompositions, Canonical_Combining_Class
  (including Virama, ccc=9), Bidi_Class and General_Category=Mark (Mn, Mc, Me).
  Hangul syllables are composed and decomposed algorithmically.
- from `CompositionExclusions.txt` with `UnicodeData.txt`, the primary composites
  for NFC, excluding Full_Composition_Exclusion (listed exclusions, singletons
  and non-starter decompositions).
- from `DerivedJoiningType.txt`, Joining_Type D, L, R and T for CONTEXTJ.

`IdnaTestV2.txt` and `NormalizationTest.txt` are test vectors only. Unicode's
data license applies to the retained data and the derived tables; its notice is
retained alongside the sources. Runtime code uses only the Go standard library
and never consults the Go `unicode` tables or the host Unicode database.

From the repository root, with Python 3.9+ and gofmt installed:

```sh
python3 -B tools/unicode_idna.py
python3 -B tools/unicode_idna.py --check
go test ./internal/idna -count=1
```

Generation and checking work offline, use these retained sources, verify every
pinned SHA-256 and resolve paths from the script. `--check` does not write files.
CI checks exact regenerated bytes; Go tests run every representable IdnaTestV2
line, every NormalizationTest line, and compare the generated mapping for every
code point with the retained mapping table. The processor runs offline with no
runtime update; changing this Unicode version requires a reviewed
data/provenance/table change.
